shared_elements: anthropomorphic figure with head at top and body below
incised linear surface detail on the head/upper body
justification: Both depict a single columnar anthropomorphic figure with a broad head at the top, limbs drawn tight against the body, and incised linear detail marking headgear or facial banding, which is a real but fairly generic correspondence. The decisive difference is that A is a fully three-dimensional composite in which a large zoomorphic creature is superposed on a crouching figure, whereas B is a flat frontal slab-figure whose torso carries low-relief regalia (a chest disc, curved ornaments and a belt band) with no second creature.
